# Mainbrella

> Cloud computers for AI agents.

Mainbrella provides isolated Linux containers with SSH and browser terminal access. Sign in and choose a monthly plan to use containers.

Plans have fixed monthly prices and no compute usage charges: Builder $5/month, Pro $180/month, and Scale $999/month. All plans use the same lite container size (256 MiB RAM, 2 GB disk) and include internet access.

Builder allows 5 concurrent containers, 10 starts per month, sessions up to 1 hour, and a 10-minute idle timeout. Pro allows 100 concurrent containers, 1,000 starts per month, sessions up to 24 hours, and a 30-minute idle timeout. Scale allows 500 concurrent containers, 10,000 starts per month, sessions up to 72 hours, and a 60-minute idle timeout.

Prototype startup benchmarks are observations, not service guarantees: 30/30 create tests succeeded at P50 381 ms and P95 528 ms; 100/100 concurrent starts succeeded at P95 680 ms.
